topic: Schumann resonance field strength scaling across eclipse stations — EXP-624 six-hole-batch verification

holes_found.description: P5 paragraph (geo-mag latitude caveat) contains an ambiguous station count. The paragraph opens 'concentrated at four stations: LER at the high-latitude end … the three corrected out-of-band stations HAD/ESK with NGK marginal'. The phrase 'three corrected out-of-band stations HAD/ESK' reads as two stations (HAD, ESK) + one marginal (NGK) = 3, which does not match 'four stations' in the same sentence — or alternatively reads HAD+ESK+NGK as the 'three', leaving LER as the fourth. P1 (same WIN) unambiguously states 'three stations clearly outside the band (HAD, ESK, LER), with NGK marginal'. A casual reader comparing P1 and P5 will find the counts inconsistent. No factual error exists; both passages are mathematically consistent when parsed carefully, but the phrasing in P5 is confusing.
holes_found.proposed_fix: In P5, change 'the three corrected out-of-band stations HAD/ESK with NGK marginal (CGM 51.85–57.5°' to 'HAD and ESK (clearly outside), with NGK marginal (CGM 51.85–57.5°' — this removes the ambiguous 'three' count and aligns with P1's explicit labelling of the three OOB stations as HAD, ESK, LER.

summary_for_decider: EXP-624 six-hole-batch: all 6 patches landed (3 find-and-replace + 3 insert-after). Checks 1, 2, 3 passed clean — new terminology present, no seam artifacts, Pearson r=0.991/r>0.85 contrast is intentional. One minor Check 5 hole: P5's 'three corrected out-of-band stations HAD/ESK with NGK marginal' is ambiguous about whether the 'three' is HAD+ESK+NGK or HAD+ESK+LER; P1 is unambiguous (three = HAD+ESK+LER, NGK marginal). Proposed fix is a 10-word rewrite in P5. FSF formula spacing inconsistency (P3 uses spaces around '/', P6 does not) is trivial and not flagged as a hole.
